create_afmoe_config: create an AfmoeConfig instance with default MoE model parameters from transformers
create_afmoe_config_experts: create an AfmoeConfig with custom num_experts and num_experts_per_tok for MoE routing
create_afmoe_config_routing: create an AfmoeConfig with custom score_func, route_norm, and route_scale routing parameters
create_afmoe_config_attention: create an AfmoeConfig with sliding_window attention and layer_types for mixed attention layers
review_afmoe_config: review the AfmoeConfig class and its MoE, routing, attention, and muP scaling parameters
